title: Wing mirror lighting and reflections
summary: Feedback centers on wing-mirror-related lighting features, with praise for blind-spot warning lights and mirror folding but complaints and observations about dashboard or ambient light reflecting into the mirrors at night.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the wing-mirror blind-spot warning lights as useful safety aids and also appreciate the automatic mirror-folding feature.

negative.summary: Negative reviews complain that dashboard, ambient, or interior lights reflect into the wing mirrors at night, making them distracting and reducing rearward visibility.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention dashboard or cockpit lighting reflecting into the wing mirrors at night, but the examples do not always make the overall sentiment explicit.

limitations: More than half of the topic reviews are undetermined, which limits confidence in a fully sentiment-resolved summary.
The sampled examples are dominated by UK fragments, with very limited evidence from other countries.
The undetermined examples mostly repeat the night-time mirror reflection issue, so evidence for other subtopics is limited.
